item.tib: dpal 'jigs byed chen po mgon po rtsa ba'i rgyud
item.skt: shri ma hA ka la mu la rtan tra ra tsa nA ma
item.coloph: dpal chen po khrag mthung he ru ka la sogs pas dgongs pa gcig tu nges pa'i don srung pa/ rdzogs s+ho// ma hA ka la rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra warna dang/ bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba mkhas pa ban d+he shes rab dpal gyi bsgyur ba'o/ /dus phyis mngaÄ ris stong tu/ /skad bsar chad kyi bcos te gtan la phab pa'o
